items.title: John L. Jones Interview, 1972-06-05
items.q: Such as the big bands like maybe Ice and Jones or somebody like that.

ctx.x: Five. Five. Five. Five. Five. Five. Well what about the white people, did they play any of those white musicians? Did they play music then?

Well we only had musicians from the Road Power Hotel used to come and sing with us. Oh I had? Such as the big bands like maybe Ice and Jones or somebody like that. All the good musicians when they get off, you see, cause at that time we was getting off at 5 o'clock. And they'd come in and it was a good place for them to jam, you know. You call it ballet, we call it jamming. It was a good place for them to jam, they would come and jam with us.
Well what were some of the big bands in New Orleans in the 30's?
